notes.title: Ver1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
From the Development Team
It has been a few days since our release, and we’re delighted to see so many players enjoying the game!
Based on feedback from live streams and player reviews, we’ve implemented updates to make the game even more enjoyable.
Please see the details below.

Update Details

* The “Return Party” event, which occurred after safely returning home on the second day, has been removed.
* The “Judgment Event After Reporting a Stranger” has been adjusted to improve its pacing and flow.
* Various typos in the dialogue have been corrected.
* The volume balance for the staff roll BGM during the “True End” was too low and has been adjusted to match the balance of the “Normal End.”
* Certain conditions for achieving the “Normal End” have been revised.
